about: Remarks on the smaller moments (sim/moments.js): ducks, maidens, big overs, jaffas, weaknesses found.

bunnings: FIRST BALL. {b} WON'T WANT TO SEE THAT AGAIN.
A GOLDEN DUCK. THE LONG WALK FEELS LONGER.
lorry: FIRST BALL! {b} IS ON HIS WAY FOR A GOLDEN DUCK!
GONE FIRST BALL! WHAT A START FOR {w}!
grog: {w} HAD A PLAN FOR {b} FROM BALL ONE. EXECUTED.
NO TIME TO SETTLE. THAT'S WHY YOU ATTACK A NEW BATTER.

bunnings: {n} BALLS AND NOTHING TO SHOW FOR IT. HARD WORK UNREWARDED.
lorry: ALL THAT EFFORT! {n} BALLS AND {b} GOES FOR NOUGHT!
{n} DELIVERIES OF RESISTANCE, AND IT ENDS IN A DUCK!
grog: {n} BALLS WITHOUT SCORING. THE PRESSURE TOLD IN THE END.
SURVIVAL WITHOUT SCORING ONLY LASTS SO LONG. {n} BALLS.

bunnings: A DUCK FOR {b}. NOT HIS DAY.
lorry: NOUGHT! {b} DOESN'T TROUBLE THE SCORERS!
{b} GONE FOR A DUCK! THE BOWLERS ARE ON TOP!
grog: {b} NEVER GOT GOING. THE BOWLERS GAVE HIM NOTHING TO HIT.
NO RUNS FOR {b}. HE COULDN'T FIND A WAY TO ROTATE STRIKE.

bunnings: THREE FOR {w}. A VERY USEFUL DAY'S WORK.
lorry: THAT'S THREE FOR {w}! HE'S ON A ROLL!
THREE WICKETS FOR {w}! THIS SPELL IS SPECIAL!
grog: {w} NOW HAS THREE. THE CAPTAIN WILL KEEP HIM ON.
THIRD WICKET FOR {w}. HE'S FOUND THE RIGHT LENGTH FOR THIS SURFACE.

bunnings: A SHY, AND A MISS. THE BATTER WAS IN TROUBLE THERE.
HAD THAT HIT, HE WAS GONE.
lorry: HE MISSED THE STUMPS! THAT WAS OUT IF IT HITS!
SO CLOSE! A DIRECT HIT AND HE WAS GONE!
grog: THE RIGHT IDEA TO SHY. THE BACKING UP WAS THE PROBLEM.
WORTH THE SHY AT THAT RANGE. THE BATTERS TOOK A BIG RISK.

bunnings: THREE IN A ROW. {w} IS UNDER SOME PRESSURE.
ANOTHER ONE. THREE BOUNDARIES ON THE TROT.
lorry: THREE IN A ROW! {b} IS TEARING INTO {w}!
AND AGAIN! THAT'S THREE BOUNDARIES IN A ROW!
grog: THREE BOUNDARIES. {w} NEEDS TO CHANGE SOMETHING: LENGTH OR FIELD.
{b} HAS TAKEN THE INITIATIVE. THREE ON THE BOUNCE.

lorry: TWO IN TWO! {b} IS AWAY!
BACK TO BACK! THE CROWD IS UP!
grog: TWO BOUNDARIES. {w} HAS DRIFTED ONTO {b}'S STRENGTHS.
BACK TO BACK. THAT CHANGES THE MOOD OF THE OVER.

lorry: INTO THE NINETIES! {b} IS ON {n}!
{b} ON {n}! THE HUNDRED IS IN SIGHT!
grog: {n}. THIS IS WHERE BATTERS TIGHTEN UP. KEEP PLAYING THE BALL.
{b} ON {n}. THE FIELD WILL COME IN TO STOP THE SINGLES.

lorry: THAT BRINGS UP THE {n}!
{n} UP FOR THE BATTING SIDE!
grog: {n} UP. NOW THE QUESTION IS HOW MANY MORE THEY CAN BUILD.
THE {n} IS UP. A PLATFORM, IF THEY KEEP WICKETS IN HAND.

lorry: {n} FROM {k}! THIS IS WHERE IT GETS INTERESTING!
THEY NEED {n} OFF {k}! GAME ON!
grog: {n} FROM {k}. ONE BIG OVER CHANGES EVERYTHING; ONE QUIET ONE ENDS IT.
{n} OFF {k}. THEY NEED BOUNDARIES, NOT JUST SINGLES.

bunnings: AN OVER {w} WILL WANT TO FORGET. {n} FROM IT.
lorry: {n} OFF THE OVER! THAT'S A BIG ONE!
WHAT AN OVER! {n} RUNS FROM IT!
grog: {n} FROM THE OVER. THE CAPTAIN MIGHT HAVE A WORD ABOUT THAT LENGTH.
{n} RUNS. ONE OVER LIKE THAT SWINGS THE MOMENTUM.

lorry: {w} HAS BEEN SUPERB! JUST {n} RUNS!
WHAT CONTROL FROM {w}! NOTHING TO HIT!
grog: {w}'S FIGURES TELL THE STORY. {n} RUNS, AND THE BATTERS ARE STUCK.
{w} HAS BOWLED TO HIS FIELD ALL SPELL. THAT'S HOW YOU BUILD PRESSURE.

bunnings: NOTHING FROM THE OVER. A MAIDEN.
lorry: A MAIDEN! {w} HAS TIED THEM DOWN!
SIX BALLS, NO RUNS! A MAIDEN FOR {w}!
grog: A MAIDEN. {w} KEPT IT IN THE CORRIDOR ALL OVER.
A MAIDEN OVER. THE PRESSURE IS QUIETLY BUILDING.

bunnings: TWO MAIDENS IN A ROW FOR {w}.
lorry: BACK-TO-BACK MAIDENS! {w} IS SQUEEZING THEM!
ANOTHER MAIDEN! THE BATTERS CAN'T GET HIM AWAY!
grog: CONSECUTIVE MAIDENS. SOMEONE WILL HAVE TO TAKE A RISK SOON.
TWO MAIDENS. THAT'S WHERE WICKETS COME FROM.

bunnings: {b} BEATEN AGAIN. HE HASN'T LAID BAT ON THAT.
lorry: BEATEN AGAIN! {w} IS ALL OVER {b}!
AND AGAIN! {b} IS GROPING!
grog: {n} TIMES BEATEN THIS OVER. {b} IS PLAYING AT DELIVERIES HE COULD LEAVE.
{w} IS FINDING THE EDGE OF THE BAT, JUST NOT THE EDGE ITSELF.

bunnings: THAT ONE DID TOO MUCH FOR ANYBODY.
lorry: WHAT A DELIVERY! {n} CENTIMETRES {k}!
AN ABSOLUTE JAFFA! UNPLAYABLE!
grog: {n} CENTIMETRES {k} AT THAT PACE. YOU CAN'T PLAN FOR THAT ONE.
THE BATTER PLAYED THE RIGHT LINE. THE BALL CHANGED IT.

bunnings: THAT WAS {n} ON THE SPEED GUN.
lorry: {n} K'S! THAT'S SERIOUS PACE!
LOOK AT THAT ON THE SPEED GUN! {n}!
grog: {n} KM/H. THE BATTER HAS FRACTIONS OF A SECOND AT THAT SPEED.
{n}. GENUINE PACE MAKES EVERY DECISION HARDER.

bunnings: THAT SWUNG {n} CENTIMETRES. QUITE A LOT.
lorry: {n} CENTIMETRES OF SWING! IT'S HOOPING!
LOOK AT IT MOVE! {n} CENTIMETRES {k}!
grog: {n} CENTIMETRES {k} IN THE AIR. THE BATTER HAS TO PLAY LATE.
SWING LIKE THAT AND YOU WANT SLIPS IN. {n} CENTIMETRES.

lorry: {n} CENTIMETRES OF TURN! IT'S SPINNING SQUARE!
IT'S RAGING! {n} CENTIMETRES {k}!
grog: {n} CENTIMETRES {k} OFF THE PITCH. THE SURFACE IS HELPING THE SPINNERS NOW.
TURN LIKE THAT BRINGS THE CLOSE CATCHERS INTO PLAY.

lorry: OOH! {b} WAS ALL AT SEA {how}!
LOOK AT THAT! {b} HAS NO IDEA {how}!
grog: WATCH {b} {how}. THERE MIGHT BE SOMETHING IN THAT.
{w} WILL HAVE NOTICED THAT. {b} {how}.

bunnings: WE'VE SEEN ENOUGH OF {b} NOW. HE'S NOT HAPPY {how}.
{b} HAS BEEN IN A WHILE. THEY'LL HAVE NOTICED HIM {how}.
lorry: THEY'VE WORKED {b} OUT! HE'S NOT SURE {how}!
I'VE SEEN IT TOO! {b} IS SHAKY {how}!
grog: FOUR OVERS IN, THE PLAN WRITES ITSELF: AT {b} {how}.
THEY'VE HAD A GOOD LOOK AT {b}. ATTACK HIM {how}.

bunnings: THAT'S TWICE NOW {how}. A WEAKNESS, I'D SAY.
{b} HAS A PROBLEM {how}. IT'S PLAIN NOW.
lorry: AGAIN! {b} JUST CANNOT COPE {how}!
THERE IT IS AGAIN! {b} IS IN ALL SORTS {how}!
grog: THAT'S THE PLAN, THEN: KEEP AT {b} {how}.
TWICE IN TROUBLE {how}. BOWL THERE AND KEEP BOWLING THERE.
